propositions: init.py at 786 LOC exceeds headroom and violates the 800-LOC hard cap by carrying two decoupled subsystems: tracker provisioning and tickets-branch convergence units
the ensure units have no calls to/from init_cli/init_core; their sole caller is _store/ensures._registry() which lazy-imports them by name
moving the five ensure units and two content templates to _init_ensures.py reduces init.py to 610 LOC while keeping _untrack_runtime_markers_unit in place because tests bind to it via monkeypatch
re-exporting moved symbols from init.py preserves module-attribute bindings required by ensures._registry() and existing test imports without requiring code changes
the seam is architecturally justified: ensures.py's docstring already recorded that the units lived in init only because they own the .gitignore/.gitattributes templates
